voice.name: Test Voice

prompt: [curious, urgent, conversational] If this parasite gets inside a fish, it can replace its entire tongue. [brisk, explaining] It crawls through the gills, latches onto the tongue, and starts stealing its blood. [quieter, uneasy] Eventually, the tongue withers away. [leaning in, slightly disturbed] But here's the disgusting part. The parasite stays attached, becoming the fish's new tongue. [unsettled, matter-of-fact] And the fish keeps eating, with a living parasite inside its mouth.
prompt_note: The approved words, verbatim (production/NARRATION_LOCKED.txt). The bracket tags direct delivery and are not spoken.
generated_once: One run of two variations (the connector default), 2 x 485.95 credits. No regeneration.

asr.zipformer_en: spellings only: 'inside of fish' for 'inside a fish', 'on to' for 'onto'

takes.why: both takes transcribe clean; this one is 0.3 s tighter (the brief asks for urgency)

edits: Speech untouched (no splice inside a word, no time-stretch, no pitch change). Five sentence-end gaps lengthened with the take's own room tone (< -45 dBFS): after 'tongue.' 0.41 -> 0.50 s, 'blood.' 0.50 -> 0.58, 'away.' 0.51 -> 0.66, 'part.' 0.35 -> 0.62, 'new tongue.' 0.47 -> 0.60; 0.72 s added in total; no gap longer than 0.66 s. Mix: gentle compressor and a look-ahead limiter on the voice.
word_timing: local sherpa-onnx Zipformer token timestamps, snapped to measured pause onsets (tools/align_zipformer.py)

final.asr_on_master: whisper base.en: 0 differences in the speech (a hallucinated 'the end' on the digital-silence tail disappears when the tail is trimmed)

listening: Not listened to in real time: this environment has no audio playback. Selection by two ASR models, pause measurement and level.
